As of the end of July 2026, the most represented countries of origin among arrivals were Somalia (22.1%), Sudan (18%), and Syria (14.5%). [...] in 2024, movement across the border fell 37 percent in 2025 compared to the previous year to 10,846, continuing into 2026 with 3,209 entries in the first seven months – 44 percent lower than the same period in 2025. The most represented countries of origin were Ukraine (primarily men of military age) and Somalia. [...] ## Central Mediterranean route to Italy

Maritime arrivals in Italy, after remaining largely unchanged between 2024 (66,617) and 2025 (66,316), fell by 55 percent in the first seven months of 2026 (16,567) compared to the same period in 2025 (36,545). In the first half of 2026, the most represented countries of origin among arrivals were Bangladesh (29.5%), Somalia (11.4%), Sudan (9.5%), Pakistan (8.2%), Algeria (7.7%), and Egypt (6.4%).
